## Everything written by this document

Built by listing the results directory and looking each file up, rather than by
keeping a list by hand. A file with no description, or a description with no
file, is reported below instead of passing unnoticed.

```{r}
file_notes = c(
  "pseudotime_per_cell.csv" = "One row per cell: library, stage, cluster, node, pseudotime and UMAP coordinates. The file every other document reads.",
  "cluster_composition.csv" = "Cells per cluster, split by cell type and library, before any subclustering.",
  "node_composition.csv"    = "Cells per node, split by library.",
  "root_marker_set_scores.csv" = "Each node scored on the germ cell marker sets. The root rule is applied to this table.",
  "mst_edges.csv"           = "Every edge of the tree with four reads on it: its length in the corrected space, where each node ranks in the other's neighbor list, the centroid distance in standard deviations of the within-node spread, its length as a percentage of the outgroup threshold, and the percentage of subsampled trees containing it.",
  "node_identity_scores.csv" = "Each node against all marker sets, somatic ones included, with a contained_in flag where one set sits inside another.",
  "node_marker_expression.csv" = "The per-gene values behind the node identity plot: percent expressing and mean log expression for every marker gene in every node.",
  "subcluster_marker_genes.csv" = "Markers of each node against the other nodes of this lineage. A within-lineage comparison, so it cannot see programs the nodes share.",
  "subcluster_marker_GO_overlaps.csv" = "Genes shared between each node marker list and each GO term.",
  "subcluster_marker_GO_pvalues.csv"  = "Enrichment of GO terms in each node marker list.",
  "tscan_pseudotime_genes.csv"        = "Genes whose expression changes along the ordering.",
  "tscan_pseudotime_GO_overlaps.csv"  = "Genes shared between the pseudotime gene list and each GO term.",
  "tscan_pseudotime_GO_pvalues.csv"   = "Enrichment of GO terms among the pseudotime-associated genes.",
  "somatic_check_set_scores.csv"      = "Every node of the annotated run scored on all marker sets, computed before any cell is removed. Only written when drop_annotations names something.",
  "annotated_run_depth_and_technical.csv" = "Depth, genes detected, percent mitochondrial, rRNA and ribosomal per node of the annotated run. Only written when drop_annotations names something.",
  "somatic_check_gene_expression.csv" = "The per-gene values behind the somatic check bubble plot. Only written when drop_annotations names something.",
  "node_depth_and_technical.csv"      = "The same four measures for this run's nodes.",
  "subcluster_depth_tests.csv"        = "Kruskal-Wallis of each measure across the subclusters, with the fold range in median depth.",
  "subcluster_downsample_check.csv"   = "Subclusters recomputed after downsampling every cell to a common depth, with the ARI against the original. A low ARI means the split was depth.",
  "subcluster_stability.csv"          = "The ARI sweep over sub_k_range. Only written when subclusters are recomputed.",
  "subcluster_k_choice.csv"           = "Each candidate k with the subcluster count it returned and its ARI. Only written when subclusters are recomputed.",
  "subcluster_annotation_map.csv"     = "Every old-new subcluster pair with shared cell counts and Jaccard. Only written when subclusters are recomputed.",
  "subcluster_overlap_grid.csv"       = "The same overlap as percentages of the new subcluster, the old one and the union. Only written when subclusters are recomputed.",
  "tscan_trajectory_umap.png"         = "UMAP colored by node and by pseudotime, with the tree drawn over it.",
  "tscan_node_graph.png"              = "The tree itself: library composition per node as pie charts, and nodes colored by mean pseudotime.",
  "tscan_node_graph.pdf"              = "The node graph as a vector file, for figure assembly.",
  "tscan_node_graph_marker_sets.png"  = "The same tree once per germ marker set, colored by expression relative to that set's maximum and sized by percent of cells detecting it.",
  "tscan_node_graph_marker_sets.pdf"  = "The marker set panels as a vector file.",
  "tscan_pseudotime_by_node.png"      = "Pseudotime distribution per node and per library.",
  "node_identity_scores.png"          = "Marker expression per node, one dot per gene.",
  "somatic_check_bubble.png"          = "Marker expression per node of the annotated run, one dot per gene. Only written when drop_annotations names something.",
  "annotated_run_depth_and_technical.png" = "Depth and technical content per node of the annotated run. Only written when drop_annotations names something.",
  "node_depth_and_technical.png"      = "Depth and technical content per node of this run.",
  "subcluster_overlap.png"            = "Old against new subclusters as percentages, three panels. Only written when subclusters are recomputed.")

in_dir  = sort(setdiff(list.files(results_dir), "Robjects"))
in_dir  = in_dir[!grepl("^tscan_heatmap_", in_dir)]

# The table describes what this document writes. The results directory also
# holds whatever earlier runs left behind, and those are named below rather
# than given rows with no description.
on_disk = intersect(names(file_notes), in_dir)
unknown = setdiff(in_dir, names(file_notes))
missing = setdiff(names(file_notes), in_dir)

export_tab = data.frame(
  file = on_disk,
  size = sapply(file.path(results_dir, on_disk),
                function(f) format(structure(file.size(f), class = "object_size"),
                                   units = "auto")),
  what = unname(file_notes[on_disk]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

datatable(export_tab, rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
          options = list(pageLength = 40, dom = "tp",
                         columnDefs = list(list(width = "260px", targets = 0))))
```

`r n_heat = length(list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^tscan_heatmap_")); if (n_heat > 0) paste0("Plus ", n_heat, " heatmap image(s) named tscan_heatmap_<path>.png, one per path through the tree.") else ""`

`r if (length(unknown) > 0) paste0(length(unknown), " file(s) in the directory are not written by this document and are left out of the table: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "), ". Either an earlier version wrote them, or they are new and need a line in file_notes.") else ""`

`r if (length(missing) > 0) paste0("Described but not written on this run: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), ". That is expected for anything the run skipped, such as the subclustering outputs when the subclusters were reused.") else ""`

`r paste0("Cached intermediates are in ", results_dir, "/Robjects and are not listed. They are rebuilt when their signature changes.")`
